title: fix(plugins): stop loading permissions after inspection fails
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: a plugin’s Permissions section keeps looking busy after its inspection request has failed, even though other settings are already usable.

## User Impact

User impact: the finished failure no longer shows a loading skeleton or claims that unknown permissions mean there are no settings. The real error and Try again remain. Existing settings stay usable, and confirmed permission controls return after retry. No grants, authorization or configuration writes change.

## Why This Change Was Made

The view previously treated missing inspection as permanent loading. It now derives pending state from the existing inspection read and carries the accepted-data distinction into the editor’s empty-state decision. This also avoids replacing the misleading skeleton with misleading “no configurable settings” guidance for plugins that only expose permission settings.

## Evidence

Actual compiled Control UI with a supported synthetic Gateway, light theme, 1280×1200 desktop. The inspected, annotated 900×900 crops preserve the error, existing settings and affected Permissions region. No live plugin operation or permission change occurred.

**Before**

![Before: plugin permissions remain loading after their inspection has failed](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/88708cbd-5079-46c8-a8e6-4c1e7526fdc9)

**After**

![After: failed inspection retains the real error and usable settings without false loading](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cfa9b9a2-17c7-4a81-b41f-5b7b4c145f1c)

- The owning regressions and main browser scenario fail on isolated main 669576890a1f0f54cf2035d0c6526bd08613dcab. The final independent patch passes both browser scenarios in 13.91s and all 20 focused owner/model/lifecycle tests in 1.30s.
- The browser follows a held initial inspection → failure → held Try again → accepted permission controls. It verifies that the existing input retains its node, value and usability, and that no configuration or enablement write is sent. A permissions-only sibling remains neutral while inspection is unknown instead of claiming there are no settings. Owning tests retain confirmed-empty and cached-permission behavior.
- Three retained-settings/read-only/recovery browser routes pass. The final patch also passes 20 Chromium editor/lifecycle cases, UI types, format and diff checks. Focused lint passes with one unchanged test-fixture warning reproduced on baseline; a rejected-toggle diagnostic remains recorded, not claimed repaired.
- Source/history review includes the original condition in #150235, its preservation through #168758, the complete detail-read owner, the inspection response producer and the installed pending-state API. The actual cold-entry flow verifies that pending inspection does not suspend already available settings.
- Self-review/simplification: three net production lines and 190 test lines. Readiness stays derived in the existing presentation path; no stored state, helper, request, cache, retry policy or permission rule was added. The empty-state check is necessary follow-through, not a separate cleanup.

This is a draft for review. Independent automated review, broad CI, phone layout and live Gateway/plugin operations are not claimed complete.

Requested and co-authored by @vyctorbrzezowski.
